item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description:
What's new

  • Corrigidos travamentos e loadings no notch e no popover durante a atualização de uso dos agentes
  • Popover agora abre instantâneo com os dados em cache e atualiza em segundo plano, sem congelar a interface
  • Corrigidas race conditions internas que podiam travar o app
  • See the full changelog for details

item.title: Version 0.2.5
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed repeated app freezes (beachball) caused by a blocked main thread during usage-metrics refresh
  • Usage metrics now refresh instantly and every 60s while the menu bar popover is open, and less often in the background — no more constant polling regardless of visibility
  • Fixed an intermittent freeze where opening the popover or notch showed a loading cursor for a few seconds, blocking notch permission buttons from being clicked

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed a bug where clicking an option in the notch could be silently ignored — most noticeable on multi-select questions, where the first option clicked wouldn't register, and the wrong selection got sent to the terminal
  • Question text no longer truncates with … on long questions — the notch now scrolls, with a fade-and-chevron hint when there's more content below the fold
  • See the full changelog for details

item.title: Version 0.2.3
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed long question descriptions getting cut off with "…" in the notch's Agent Asks card — they now scroll instead
  • Fixed a crash (silent app close) that could happen while answering a free-text question

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description:
Zeep Pulse 0.2.2

Fixed

  • Answering an AskUserQuestion from the notch silently failed to reach the terminal once enough Orca terminals were open. The handle lookup (orca terminal list) produces a large JSON payload, and a pipe-buffer deadlock made it time out and fall back to a stale handle, so no keystrokes were ever sent. The subprocess output is now drained correctly regardless of size.
  • Multi-select questions stalled before submitting: the selection was toggled correctly but never confirmed, because pressing Enter on a checkbox row only toggles it. The answer now navigates to the picker's Submit button before confirming, so multi-select and multi-question wizards complete end-to-end.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
What's new in 0.2.1

  • Multi-page AskUserQuestion wizards no longer hang the terminal. Answering a multi-question prompt from the notch now delivers every answer to the agent and returns control cleanly — no more freeze that only recovered with Ctrl+C.
  • Metrics now report to the new production endpoint.
  • Fixed the anonymous firstSeenAt install date not persisting between launches.
  • Updated English and pt-BR translations.
  • See the full changelog for details.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
Zeep Pulse 0.2.0

New

  • Full wizard support for Claude Code's AskUserQuestion: multi-select and multi-question tool calls can now be answered directly from the notch (previously broken/unsupported)
  • Sessions appear as "Active" as soon as the CLI opens, no need to send a first prompt (Claude Code, OpenCode)
  • Customizable notch alert sound (7 options, with a preview button in Settings)
  • Toggle to hide the notch on the MacBook's built-in display (mirrors the existing external-display behavior)
  • Silent update check every time the menu bar popover opens, with an in-popover "Update available" banner and one-click Update button
  • "Automatically download updates" toggle in About Settings
  • Menu bar popover: fixed-order provider tabs (Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode), CodexBar-style progress bar and pace text, local 30-day Claude cost/token history via on-disk log parsing

Fixed

  • Frequent macOS Keychain prompts for Claude Code credentials — now reads the local credentials file first, adds a 6h cooldown after a denial, shows an explanatory alert before the real prompt, and adds a "Disable Keychain access" toggle in Advanced Settings
  • Regression where the manual "Connect" button for Claude Code usage stopped working after the Keychain cooldown fix above
  • Two or more agents sending permission/question requests at nearly the same time — only the first one was answerable, the rest got stuck (now queued properly)
  • Menu bar popover not closing automatically after clicking Settings / Check for Updates / Quit
  • Missing and broken pt-BR translations across the app, including a bug where Text(condition ? "literal" : variable) never localized at all
  • Claude cost tracking silently ignoring Sonnet 5 usage (missing pricing entry)

Removed

  • Usage metrics no longer shown in the notch overlay (still available in the menu bar popover)
  • OpenCode session/weekly quota — no official API exists for the Go plan, and a from-scratch browser-cookie based estimate was removed after proving unreliable. Local cost/token stats (via opencode stats) are unaffected.

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed the app becoming unresponsive ("App Not Responding") — a blocking process call on the main thread at launch and whenever agent hooks refresh (e.g. changing Settings > Agents or the socket path) could hang indefinitely
  • Fixed a thread leak in the internal socket server that occurred on every restart
  • See the full changelog for details

item.title: Version 0.1.6
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed an intermittent crash caused by a data race in SocketServer
  • Added anonymous install/update usage tracking — no user data, no PII collected
  • See the full changelog for details

item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed the refresh button (menu bar and notch) doing nothing when the Claude Code Keychain permission expired — it now retries authentication instead of silently failing
  • Fixed the notch permission/question card staying stuck on screen when you answered directly in the terminal instead of clicking Allow/Deny
  • Fixed usage-limit notifications: Claude Code no longer re-notifies at the same percentage on every refresh, and OpenCode no longer sends bogus percentage alerts based on session count

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed the install DMG showing a giant, cropped version of the logo as the background — it's now a small wordmark in the top-left corner

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed auto-update: the app's embedded Sparkle public key never matched the actual signing key, so every update signature failed verification ("Erro de atualização!"). If you're on 0.1.1 or 0.1.2, download and install this version manually once — Sparkle auto-update will work correctly from here on.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
What's new

  • Fixed Claude Code's usage reset countdown never updating — a JSON decode bug always fell back to a fake "now + 5h" instead of the real reset time from Anthropic's API
  • Fixed usage refresh only ever checking one provider instead of all of them, and pausing whenever the app lost focus (which, for a menu-bar app, was almost always)
  • Added a Quit button to Settings, and a Check for Updates… button to the menu bar popover
  • Settings window now scrolls when content doesn't fit, and no longer misaligns when it does
  • Fixed "File ▸ Settings…" and "About" opening a blank window instead of the real UI — both are already one click away from the notch/menu bar
  • About pane now shows the real app version and an auto-updating copyright year
  • Onboarding's permission step is now real: Notifications, Accessibility, Automation, and Launch at Login actually request and reflect system state instead of being disconnected toggles
  • Keychain access no longer prompts during the splash screen — deferred until onboarding finishes
  • Portuguese (Brazil) translations added for all of the above

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
Zeep Pulse 0.1.1

  • Auto-update via Sparkle — the app now checks for new versions and can update itself (Settings → About → "Check for Updates…")
  • Fixed the notch getting stuck expanded after answering a permission or question request
  • Jump-back now switches to the exact terminal tab/session instead of just the frontmost window (Terminal.app, iTerm2, Orca)
  • Fixed automation permissions never prompting for Terminal/System Events access
  • Permission and question cards now show a countdown and expire cleanly instead of silently doing nothing after the agent's decision window closes
  • New notch alert sound
  • Portuguese (Brazil) localization
  • "Start at login" toggle now actually works
